$comment: Every JOSE identifier polyjose recognises. Names are IANA JOSE registry spellings. level is the registry's JOSE Implementation Requirements value; spec is the defining RFC section; levelSpec is set only when another RFC changed the level. status is one of yes, verify-only, encrypt-only, no. notSupported is a heading id on /security/not-supported/.

groups.caption: JWS signature and MAC algorithms (the alg header parameter)

rows.name: HS256
rows.note: A key shorter than the hash output is rejected with `InvalidKey`, when signing and when verifying.

rows.name: RS256
rows.note: Verifying works, so tokens from identity providers can be checked. Signing fails with `UnsupportedAlgorithm`.

rows.name: PS256
rows.description: RSASSA-PSS using SHA-256 and MGF1 with SHA-256

rows.name: PS384
rows.description: RSASSA-PSS using SHA-384 and MGF1 with SHA-384

rows.name: PS512
rows.description: RSASSA-PSS using SHA-512 and MGF1 with SHA-512

rows.name: ES256
rows.note: Verifying accepts both forms of the `s` value; signing always produces the low form. Don't use a token's exact bytes as a replay key: use the `jti` claim.

rows.name: ES256K
rows.description: ECDSA using secp256k1 curve and SHA-256

rows.name: Ed25519
rows.description: EdDSA using the Ed25519 parameter set (RFC 8032 §5.1)
rows.note: Recommended for new tokens. Verification is strict: small-order public keys are rejected.

rows.name: EdDSA
rows.note: Kept for existing tokens and peers. polyjose uses it with Ed25519 keys only. `EdDSA` and `Ed25519` are separate entries in an allow-list and in a JWK's `alg`.

rows.name: none
rows.description: No digital signature or MAC performed
rows.note: Recognised so the error is precise, and never accepted: a token with `alg: none`, or an allow-list that names it, fails with `AlgorithmNotAllowed`.

groups.caption: JWE key management algorithms (the alg header parameter)

rows.name: RSA-OAEP-256
rows.description: RSAES OAEP using SHA-256 and MGF1 with SHA-256
rows.note: You can encrypt to an RSA recipient. Decrypting needs the RSA private key, which polyjose does not use.

rows.name: A128GCMKW
rows.description: Key wrapping with AES GCM using 128-bit key

rows.name: A192GCMKW
rows.description: Key wrapping with AES GCM using 192-bit key

rows.name: A256GCMKW
rows.description: Key wrapping with AES GCM using 256-bit key

rows.name: dir
rows.description: Direct use of a shared symmetric key
rows.key: oct, the size the enc algorithm needs

rows.name: ECDH-ES
rows.note: X25519 follows RFC 8037 §3.2. The sender's ephemeral public key is validated before use.

rows.name: ECDH-ES+A128KW
rows.description: ECDH-ES using Concat KDF and "A128KW" wrapping

rows.name: ECDH-ES+A192KW
rows.description: ECDH-ES using Concat KDF and "A192KW" wrapping

rows.name: ECDH-ES+A256KW
rows.description: ECDH-ES using Concat KDF and "A256KW" wrapping

rows.name: PBES2-HS256+A128KW
rows.description: PBES2 with HMAC SHA-256 and "A128KW" wrapping
rows.note: Bounded: decryption accepts at most 10,000 iterations (`p2c`) unless you raise the limit explicitly, up to 1,000,000. Encryption uses 10,000 by default. A larger `p2c` fails with `DecryptionFailed`.

rows.name: PBES2-HS384+A192KW
rows.description: PBES2 with HMAC SHA-384 and "A192KW" wrapping
rows.note: Bounded at 10,000 iterations by default, as above.

rows.name: PBES2-HS512+A256KW
rows.description: PBES2 with HMAC SHA-512 and "A256KW" wrapping
rows.note: Bounded at 10,000 iterations by default, as above.

rows.name: RSA-OAEP
rows.note: Uses SHA-1. A header or JWK with `alg: RSA-OAEP` fails with `UnsupportedAlgorithm`. Use `RSA-OAEP-256`, or ECDH-ES.

rows.name: RSA1_5
rows.note: Not implemented in either direction; it fails with `UnsupportedAlgorithm`.

groups.caption: JWE content encryption algorithms (the enc header parameter)

rows.name: DEF
rows.note: Rust only, with the `deflate` feature, which is off by default. Decompression is capped at 250,000 bytes by default, and runs only after the authentication tag checks. Without the feature, and in the Node, Web, Kotlin and Swift packages, `zip` fails with `UnsupportedAlgorithm`.
